paragraphs.text: Dyadrine is a Construct from the Edge .

Dyadrine is a mechan construct of unknown origin that was abandoned on an uncharted moon in the Sothera system of the Edge. The scarcity of suitable resources for it to use meant it could not self repair via nanotechnology like it normally would. Stranded on the planet for years, it eventually identified that the native plants possessed qualities that allowed it to graft them into itself. This process integrated the plant-based components into the construct’s systems causing roots to embed themselves organically throughout its body. Over time, the combination of biological and mechanical pieces entered a state of complete synthesis, completing becoming an inseparable part of the construct. This has caused Dyadrine to show an accelerated need to absorb nutrients similar to that of the local plant life.
